correctness.rationale: For a nonzero square-zero matrix the image and kernel are the same line L. In a basis starting with L, each perturbation is tE12 with t nonzero, and det(A+tE12)=det A−ct, where c is the lower-left entry of A. Thus an invariant line supplies q−1 central points and any other line supplies one point to every off-center fiber; add N=0. Trace is fixed. In characteristic two, trace zero requires a scalar diagonalizable part and the unique scalar gives a square-zero difference by Cayley–Hamilton; nonzero trace gives q/2 split determinant values via the involution r↦s−r. In odd characteristic the split-distinct set has (q−1)/2 values by the discriminant test, and the scalar correction is one exactly when the original discriminant vanishes. Summing the corresponding fibers reproduces all case counts, including q=2 and q=3.
residual_risks: The frozen exhaustive outputs for q=2,3,4,5,7,8 are recorded evidence, not a fresh execution. The projective-line proof applies to arbitrary finite fields independently of those tests.

evidence: For trace s, each split determinant z=r(s−r) with distinct roots corresponds to the zero determinant fiber of (A−rI)+N, since square-zero perturbations preserve trace. Thus even the earlier d_q formula, applied to scalar shifts, supplies every distinct-split count. At a repeated root only a scalar is diagonalizable, contributing one exactly when the scalar difference is square-zero.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Both the all-z law and the complete ordered multiplicities follow by direct substitution and elementary characteristic-polynomial bookkeeping; no new count or structural obstruction is obtained.

originality.rationale: The earlier Resultary record 7b7188752131 already gives the complete needed level-set calculation in its proof. It expands det(A−N) as det A plus a linear form on the nilpotent cone, identifies precisely e(A) annihilated rays, and counts the zero and prescribed nonzero levels. Replacing the prescribed value −det A by z−det A gives the frozen fiber formula verbatim after changing N to −N. The decomposition multiplicities then follow mechanically from the degree-two split-polynomial count and the possible scalar correction. The difference between invertible and diagonalizable summands in the two headlines does not remove this implication.
residual_risks: The 2022 original proof is inaccessible through the inspected lawful routes. That has no bearing on the demonstrated earlier coverage by 7b7188752131.
